office order no .3019/32-JS/2020, 18-05-2023, order no. 4229/JS/, 02-07-2021, order no. 5862/JS,
03-09-2021 , order no. 2385/JS, 28-04-2022.
4. Candidates are requested to carefully read the General Information & Instructions before filling up
the Online Application Form available on the University Website:www.csjmu.ac.in.
5. The Candidates are also advised to visit the university website periodically for further information
and updates related to the recruitment process.
6. The online application process shall start on 02 May, 2025 and the last date for filling online
application is 31 May, 2025.
7. Candidates are required to submit the hardcopy of the duly filled Application Form along with
supporting documents (each page duly signed) and transaction receipt by Registered/Speed post
to The Registrar, Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University, Kalyanpur, Kanpur – 208024
(U.P.) latest by 07 June 2025.The envelope on its top shall mention the advertisement number,
post applied, and department name.
8. Application, incomplete in any respect and without relevant Certificates/ Documents/
Photographs/Orders, as desired or without requisite Fee will be rejected.
9. The application fee is Rs. 2500/- (Rs. 2000/- for SC/ST candidates only) which will be paid online
alongwith online application.
10. Application fee once submitted is NON-REFUNDABLE.
11. Candidate applying for more than one positions shall apply separately and must submit
application fee for each application separately.
12. The reservation for the posts will be as per the U.P. State Govt. norms.
13. SC/ST/OBC/EWS/UR stands for Schedule Caste, Schedule Tribe, Other Backward Classes,
Economic Weaker Section and Unreserved category respectively.
14. SC/ST candidates must enclose with the Application a ‘hard copy’ of the Caste Certificate on
prescribed Format of the Government of U.P., duly issued by the Competent Authority.
15. OBC (Non-creamy Layer) candidates must enclose with the Application a ‘hard copy’ of the Caste
Certificate/Income Certificate on prescribed Format of the Government of U.P., duly issued by the
Competent Authority on or after 30 November 2024 .
16. EWS candidates are required to submit a certificate in prescribed format of the Government of
U.P., duly issued by the Competent Authority on or after 30 November 2024.
17. A candidate already in employment is required to submit the ‘No Objection Certificate’ at the
time of submitting online application form or at the time of interview.
18. Experience and Qualifications will be reckoned as on the last date of submission of application
form.
19. No T.A./D.A. shall be paid for attending the interview.
20. No claim for regular appointment/regularization shall be entertained at any stage.
21. No ‘Interim Correspondence’ shall be entertained.
